positive_policy: one distinct train user-item pair; anchor at first_pair_time
history_policy: event_time strictly before prediction_time; exclude whole current timestamp group
unknown_policy: retain native IDs and null model index; no invented learned factor
evaluation_policy: first next timestamp; retain all distinct tied items, repeats and outside-candidate labels

sampler.exclude: all observed train items for this user

text.item: title_description_exact_paragraph_dedup_v1; title fallback; metadata snapshot without historical versions
text.review: usable review title and body; remove exact title-body repetition
text.blank: null text_id plus missing flag; event/item retained
text.dedup: encode unique text; preserve event multiplicity in local references

encoder.chunk_policy: non-overlapping tokenizer overflow chunks; normalize each chunk; token-weighted mean; L2 normalize final text vector

tables.history_events: one Silver record, no review text copied; keys user_id,parent_asin,event_time,record_hash
tables.train_pairs: one distinct user-item pair with Int indices, first_pair_time,event_count,strength=1
tables.train_examples: same positives across NCF/D0/D1/D2; prediction_time=first_pair_time, including empty history
tables.queries: one labeled user at fixed prediction_time; input columns only
tables.labels: one query-target item; evaluation only, target time and source reference
tables.candidates: all distinct training items, including repeat items
tables.users: native user_id to deterministic sorted Int index, train-only
tables.items: native parent_asin to deterministic sorted Int index, train-only
tables.item_text_refs: one refit candidate item to nullable text_id; local/HDFS only
tables.review_text_refs: one history Silver record to nullable text_id; local/HDFS only

artifact_policy: immutable complete Gold; embeddings are separate versioned bundles; no raw/user IDs/labels in Kaggle package
